steps.name: room-rpcs
steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261029010000_room_rpcs.sql: create_room(p_name,p_base_currency,p_start_date?,p_end_date?)→uuid · preview_invite(p_token)→jsonb{room_id,room_name,inviter_nickname,member_count,already_member} · join_room(p_token)→uuid(신규 INSERT+room_events 'join', 재합류는 left_at=null·같은 id) · update_room(p_room_id,p_name,p_base_currency,p_start_date,p_end_date)→void(방장만, CURRENCY_LOCKED) · rotate_invite(p_room_id)→text + 내부 헬퍼 new_invite_token()(22자 128비트, 실행권한 전면 회수). 에러는 P0001+FORBIDDEN/INVALID_INPUT/INVITE_INVALID/CURRENCY_LOCKED. supabase/tests/010_room_rpcs.test.sql(39개, 전체 73개 통과)

steps.name: save-expense
steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261029020000_save_expense.sql: save_expense(p_payload jsonb, p_expected_version int default null)→jsonb{id,version,krw_amount,fx_source,fx_rate,fx_base_date}(id 기준 멱등·VERSION_CONFLICT, 원화 확정 KRW→krw_charged(card_krw)→manual_rate→room_fx_overrides(manual)→fx_rates 10일(kexim)→pending, 박스 정수 최대 잔여 배분, 갱신 시 날짜·통화·금액·청구액·수동환율 불변이면 기존 확정 유지) · delete_expense(p_id,p_expected_version)→void(소프트 삭제+version+1, 재호출 멱등) · reconfirm_pending_fx(p_room_id)→int · expense_history(p_expense_id)→setof jsonb{id,action,actor_id,actor_nickname,at,snapshot}(삭제 포함) + 내부 헬퍼 _lookup_fx(text,date)·_allocate_items(uuid)·_expense_snapshot(uuid)·_record_history(uuid,text)(실행권한 전면 회수). 에러 P0001+FORBIDDEN/INVALID_INPUT/AMOUNT_INVALID/DATE_IN_FUTURE/SCOPE_EMPTY/MEMBER_LEFT/INVALID_PAYER/VERSION_CONFLICT. supabase/tests/020_save_expense.test.sql(59개, 전체 132개 통과)

steps.name: room-balances
steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261029030000_room_balances.sql: room_balances(p_room_id uuid, p_confirmed_only bool default false)→table(member_id,kind,representative_member_id,joined_at,left_at,paid,owed,net bigint,fx_pending_count int)(활성 멤버만 호출·FORBIDDEN, 나간 멤버·게스트 행 포함, 공금 행 없음, floor 분담+자투리는 결제자/공금이면 통장 주인, 남은 공금은 통장 주인 owed, 무효 송금 제외·confirmed_only면 확인분만, 게스트 net=0·현재 대표자 net에 합산, Σnet≠0이면 예외) · my_rooms()→table(room_id,name,base_currency,start_date,end_date,status 'settled'|'settling'|'shared'|'solo',member_count(게스트 포함 활성),total_krw,my_net)(내 활성·미삭제 방, created_at desc). supabase/tests/030_room_balances.test.sql(39개, 전체 171개 통과)

steps.name: transfers-leave
steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261029040000_transfers_leave.sql: record_transfer(p_id,p_room_id,p_from_member_id,p_to_member_id,p_amount_krw bigint)→void(p_id 멱등, 당사자는 이 방 user 참여자만·FORBIDDEN, 나간 멤버 MEMBER_LEFT, from=to INVALID_INPUT, amount≤0 AMOUNT_INVALID, 호출자가 from이면 미확인·to면 즉시 confirmed_at, room_events 'transfer' payload{transfer_id,from_member_id,to_member_id,amount_krw}, recorded_by=호출자) · confirm_transfer(p_id)/reject_transfer(p_id)(to 본인만, 무효면 FORBIDDEN, reject=void_reason 'not_received') · cancel_transfer(p_id)(from 본인만, 확인됐으면 ALREADY_CONFIRMED, 'cancelled') · leave_room(p_room_id)→void(차단 순서 GUEST_REPRESENTATIVE→POOL_OWNER→FX_PENDING_EXISTS→BALANCE_NOT_ZERO(room_balances(…,true)), left_at+room_events 'leave', 방장이면 joined_at·id 순 첫 활성 user에게 위임+'owner_change', 마지막 활성 user면 rooms.deleted_at) + 내부 헬퍼 _lock_transfer(uuid,text)(실행권한 전면 회수). supabase/tests/040_transfers_leave.test.sql(54개, 전체 225개 통과)
